# ASCII Sharks

Source: https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks (main, retrieved 2026-11-06).

Copyright (c) 2026 drewdi; MIT license in LICENSE. The renderer's background
grid is disabled for a plain backdrop; the remaining upstream modules are
unchanged. CSS converts the canvas to monochrome dark sharks on white.

The sharks AsciiBackground component manages the engine lifecycle.
No video file, remote script, or extra dependency is needed at runtime.
